title: Convex Deployment, project and admin key (hex body): one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 4 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: _x glued after the hex body, boundary: a cloud name with _ in place of -, outside the CLI name grammar, and boundary: a space between the name and the | join, so | follows no name byte, and 1 more. Twin of "Convex Deployment, project and admin key (hex body): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of convex-deployment-key-bare-prose: boundary: a space between the name and the | join, so | follows no name byte. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
